These fixtures derive from the `渡口` examples at upstream commit
`8af10e0e`; licensing and attribution are in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
The art image objects additionally contain `promptLocal`, copied from their
Chinese summaries. The original storyboard covers episode 1 only, and its
opening blocking does not match the independently supplied staging example.
The storyboard validator accepts it as an illustrative partial example; it is
not a complete validated production handoff.

`mini/` is a two-episode test-only adaptation of those examples: the outline,
cast and art are reduced to two characters, one location and one prop; the
script, staging and English storyboard are constructed for a 12-second test.
The first segment uses the staging CLI's generated opening. These documents
exercise validators and orchestration, and are not a production plan.
